label: Matt 12:1
text: At that time, Jesus went on the Sabbath day through the grain fields. His disciples were hungry and began to pluck heads of grain and to eat.

label: Matt 12:2
text: But the Pharisees, when they saw it, said to him, “Behold, your disciples do what is not lawful to do on the Sabbath.”

label: Matt 12:3
text:
But he said to them,
“Haven’t you read what David did, when he was hungry, and those who were with him;

label: Matt 12:4
text: how he entered into God’s house, and ate the show bread, which was not lawful for him to eat, neither for those who were with him, but only for the priests?

label: Matt 12:5
text: Or have you not read in the law, that on the Sabbath day, the priests in the temple profane the Sabbath, and are guiltless?

label: Matt 12:6
text: But I tell you that one greater than the temple is here.

label: Matt 12:7
text:
But if you had known what this means, ‘I desire mercy, and not sacrifice,’
you wouldn’t have condemned the guiltless.

label: Matt 12:8
text: For the Son of Man is Lord of the Sabbath.”

label: Matt 12:9
text: He departed there, and went into their synagogue.

label: Matt 12:10
text: And behold there was a man with a withered hand. They asked him, “Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath day?” that they might accuse him.

label: Matt 12:11
text:
He said to them,
“What man is there among you, who has one sheep, and if this one falls into a pit on the Sabbath day, won’t he grab on to it, and lift it out?

label: Matt 12:12
text: Of how much more value then is a man than a sheep! Therefore it is lawful to do good on the Sabbath day.”

label: Matt 12:13
text:
Then he told the man,
“Stretch out your hand.” He stretched it out; and it was restored whole, just like the other.

label: Matt 12:14
text: But the Pharisees went out, and conspired against him, how they might destroy him.

label: Matt 12:15
text: Jesus, perceiving that, withdrew from there. Great multitudes followed him; and he healed them all,

label: Matt 12:16
text: and commanded them that they should not make him known:

label: Matt 12:17
text: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through Isaiah the prophet, saying,

label: Matt 12:18
text:
“Behold, my servant whom I have chosen;
my beloved in whom my soul is well pleased:
I will put my Spirit on him.
He will proclaim justice to the nations.

label: Matt 12:19
text:
He will not strive, nor shout;
neither will anyone hear his voice in the streets.

label: Matt 12:20
text:
He won’t break a bruised reed.
He won’t quench a smoking flax,
until he leads justice to victory.

label: Matt 12:21
text: In his name, the nations will hope.”

label: Matt 12:22
text: Then one possessed by a demon, blind and mute, was brought to him and he healed him, so that the blind and mute man both spoke and saw.

label: Matt 12:23
text: All the multitudes were amazed, and said, “Can this be the son of David?”

label: Matt 12:24
text: But when the Pharisees heard it, they said, “This man does not cast out demons, except by Beelzebul, the prince of the demons.”

label: Matt 12:25
text:
Knowing their thoughts, Jesus said to them,
“Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation, and every city or house divided against itself will not stand.

label: Matt 12:26
text: If Satan casts out Satan, he is divided against himself. How then will his kingdom stand?

label: Matt 12:27
text: If I by Beelzebul cast out demons, by whom do your children cast them out? Therefore they will be your judges.

label: Matt 12:28
text: But if I by the Spirit of God cast out demons, then God’s Kingdom has come upon you.

label: Matt 12:29
text: Or how can one enter into the house of the strong man, and plunder his goods, unless he first bind the strong man? Then he will plunder his house.

label: Matt 12:30
text: “He who is not with me is against me, and he who doesn’t gather with me, scatters.

label: Matt 12:31
text: Therefore I tell you, every sin and blasphemy will be forgiven men, but the blasphemy against the Spirit will not be forgiven men.

label: Matt 12:32
text: Whoever speaks a word against the Son of Man, it will be forgiven him; but whoever speaks against the Holy Spirit, it will not be forgiven him, neither in this age, nor in that which is to come.

label: Matt 12:33
text: “Either make the tree good, and its fruit good, or make the tree corrupt, and its fruit corrupt; for the tree is known by its fruit.

label: Matt 12:34
text: You offspring of vipers, how can you, being evil, speak good things? For out of the abundance of the heart, the mouth speaks.

label: Matt 12:35
text:
The good man out of his good treasure brings out good things, and the evil man out of his evil treasure
brings out evil things.

label: Matt 12:36
text: I tell you that every idle word that men speak, they will give account of it in the day of judgment.

label: Matt 12:37
text: For by your words you will be justified, and by your words you will be condemned.”

label: Matt 12:38
text: Then certain of the scribes and Pharisees answered, “Teacher, we want to see a sign from you.”

label: Matt 12:39
text:
But he answered them,
“An evil and adulterous generation seeks after a sign, but no sign will be given to it but the sign of Jonah the prophet.

label: Matt 12:40
text: For as Jonah was three days and three nights in the belly of the whale, so will the Son of Man be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.

label: Matt 12:41
text: The men of Nineveh will stand up in the judgment with this generation, and will condemn it, for they repented at the preaching of Jonah; and behold, someone greater than Jonah is here.

label: Matt 12:42
text: The queen of the south will rise up in the judgment with this generation, and will condemn it, for she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and behold, someone greater than Solomon is here.

label: Matt 12:43
text: When an unclean spirit has gone out of a man, he passes through waterless places, seeking rest, and doesn’t find it.

label: Matt 12:44
text: Then he says, ‘I will return into my house from which I came out,’ and when he has come back, he finds it empty, swept, and put in order.

label: Matt 12:45
text: Then he goes, and takes with himself seven other spirits more evil than he is, and they enter in and dwell there. The last state of that man becomes worse than the first. Even so will it be also to this evil generation.”

label: Matt 12:46
text: While he was yet speaking to the multitudes, behold, his mother and his brothers stood outside, seeking to speak to him.

label: Matt 12:47
text: One said to him, “Behold, your mother and your brothers stand outside, seeking to speak to you.”

label: Matt 12:48
text:
But he answered him who spoke to him,
“Who is my mother? Who are my brothers?”

label: Matt 12:49
text:
He stretched out his hand towards his disciples, and said,
“Behold, my mother and my brothers!

label: Matt 12:50
text: For whoever does the will of my Father who is in heaven, he is my brother, and sister, and mother.”

label: Plucking grain on the Sabbath
statement: On a Sabbath Jesus walked through the grain fields and his hungry disciples began to pluck heads of grain and eat.

label: Plucking grain as unlawful Sabbath work
statement: The Pharisees held the disciples' plucking of grain on the Sabbath to be work that was not lawful to do.

label: David ate the showbread
statement: David, when hungry, entered the house of God and ate the showbread, which was lawful for the priests alone.

label: Priests' Sabbath service in the temple
statement: The priests work in the temple on the Sabbath days and are held guiltless of profaning the Sabbath.

label: Teaching in their synagogue
statement: Jesus departed and went into a synagogue in Galilee, where he taught.

label: Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath?
statement: Healing on the Sabbath was a live question of law: 'Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath day?'

label: The sheep fallen into a pit on the Sabbath
statement: A man would lift his one sheep out of a pit on the Sabbath day.

label: The withered hand restored
statement: A man with a withered hand was healed in the synagogue; he stretched it out and it was restored whole.

label: The Pharisees' plot to destroy Jesus
statement: The Pharisees went out and conspired against Jesus, how they might destroy him.

label: Isaiah 42:1-4 quoted
statement: Matthew 12:18-21 quotes Isaiah 42:1-4 as what was spoken through Isaiah the prophet.

label: The blind and mute demoniac healed
statement: A demon-possessed man who was blind and mute was brought to Jesus and healed, so that he spoke and saw.

label: Can this be the son of David?
statement: The crowds asked in amazement whether Jesus could be the son of David, the messianic title.

label: Beelzebul, prince of the demons
statement: The Pharisees said Jesus cast out demons by Beelzebul, the prince of the demons.

label: 'By whom do your sons cast them out?'
statement: Jewish exorcists - 'your sons' - cast out demons in the period.

label: Brood of vipers
statement: The invective 'offspring of vipers' was addressed to the Pharisees.

label: The sign of Jonah the prophet
statement: No sign would be given to that evil and adulterous generation except the sign of Jonah the prophet.

label: The men of Nineveh repented
statement: The men of Nineveh repented at the preaching of Jonah.

label: Nineveh, a great city
statement: Nineveh, the city of Jonah's preaching, was a great city.

label: The queen of the south and Solomon's wisdom
statement: The queen of the south came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon.

label: The unclean spirit in waterless places
statement: An unclean spirit was believed to pass through waterless places seeking rest.

label: His mother and brothers outside
statement: The mother and brothers of Jesus stood outside, seeking to speak to him.

label: Jesus' brother James
statement: Jesus had brothers, among them James ('the brother of Jesus, who was called Christ', Josephus, Ant. 20).
